data.AgentGovernance__Policy__PlatformPolicyD:
apiVersion: governance.toolkit/v1
version: "1.0"
name: p1-platform-baseline
scope: global
default_action: deny
rules:
  - name: allow-model-turn
    condition: "action_id == 'model.turn'"
    action: allow
    priority: 100
  - name: allow-tool-read
    condition: "action_id == 'tool.read'"
    action: allow
    priority: 100
  - name: allow-tool-write
    condition: "action_id == 'tool.write'"
    action: allow
    priority: 100
  - name: allow-exec-shell
    condition: "action_id == 'exec.shell'"
    action: allow
    priority: 100
  - name: allow-exec-read
    condition: "action_id == 'exec.read'"
    action: allow
    priority: 100
  - name: allow-exec-write
    condition: "action_id == 'exec.write'"
    action: allow
    priority: 100
  - name: allow-exec-stop
    condition: "action_id == 'exec.stop'"
    action: allow
    priority: 100
